scripts.build: npm run content:build && npm run build -w @bb/festival
scripts.test: npm run content:build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.emulators: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH npx --yes firebase-tools@15.30.0 emulators:start --only firestore,auth --config firebase/firebase.json --project bb-festival-2026
scripts.rules:test: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH npx --yes firebase-tools@15.30.0 emulators:exec --only firestore --config firebase/firebase.json --project bb-festival-2026 "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.rules:deploy: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.30.0 deploy --only firestore --config firebase/firebase.json --project bb-festival-2026
